title: Looking back at your days in training, what do you wish you knew then?
summary: We asked our experts what advice they'd share with trainees about what they wish they knew then. 1. Daniel E. Spratt, MD Chair and Professor | Case Western Reserve University/University Hospitals Seidman Cancer Center While this seems like such a simple question, it is so complex as if I knew
body_text: We asked our experts what advice they'd share with trainees about what they wish they knew then. 1. Daniel E. Spratt, MD Chair and Professor | Case Western Reserve University/University Hospitals Seidman Cancer Center While this seems like such a simple question, it is so complex as if I knew the things I know now I am sure my actions would have changed...which would lead me to a different life today; the great butterfly effect: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Butterfly_effect . Trying to put that aside, a few pearls/maxims I often share with students, residents, and fellows: Always try to align your "needs" and your "wants". Don't blindly just do what is asked of you. Proactively shape what fills your day up as much as possible. Master the art of creating your own path respectfully and professionally. It is ok to say no, and you need to learn how to say no in a manner that is professional and respectful and that demonstrates you are saying no for a reason and not because you are lazy, but rather, that task is not aligned with your purpose or current goals. Stay humble and know we are all replaceable. That doesn't mean we don't have value, but one must understand the tiny role any of us have in the scope of a huge multi-billion dollar institution. Never lose track of your purpose. Mine is to provide a positive impact on cancer patients' lives. Stay focused. If you don't actively think about your purpose, you will end up on someone else's path in life heading down a road you don't want to be on. You will be criticized on your journey. Attendings, leaders, program directors, Chairs, random people, etc may tell you that you are doing it all wrong over and over. You must have enough self-confidence and introspection to identify when you have failed versus others trying to tear you down to benefit themselves. This is not easy. Try to listen to the people that matter in your life (family, friends, patients, trusted peers, etc). Don't expect the same from others as you do yourself. Everyone's goals are different. Meetings can be 10-15 minutes. Don't agree for every meeting with your attending to be 30 min or 1 hour unless it really needs to be. Know the currency of the stage you are at in life. If you are a resident then usually the currency is working hard, having a positive attitude, reading and knowing your craft, and getting the work/job done. This will typically be the most important thing that your attendings can use to help you get a job. If you want to be a physician-scientist, you likely will also need the currency of a focused scientific path and scholarly work (papers, grants, etc)....or at least a real potential for these in the future. Publishing a bunch of random junk rarely will help you get a job. Complaining, laziness, being demanding, etc will surely be a great way to make it hard to get hired. Leaders, attendings, Chairs, PDs, etc...just having a title doesn't mean they are smarter than you, are always right, or are a better clinician than you. You must take the good from each person in training and try to filter out the bad or the style that doesn't fit with your personality. You can be a great clinician in dozens of ways, and you need to figure out the kind YOU want to be. Read the book Multipliers. One of the few books I read in residency that opened my eyes to many terrible leaders I have worked under and the many amazing ones. The philosophy of this book changed the way I work in all aspects of my life. Be a multiplier and work with multipliers. Avoid diminishers at all costs. Getting a job is more about "fit" on both ends than it is about a big CV. Do not underestimate the power of your attending or mentor picking up the phone and calling their peers at the center you want to work. That goes a long way. There will be conflict/drama as a resident at some point, but remember this usually disappears within days and is forgotten. Try to keep perspective. As hard as you may work in training, remember that in oncology, on the other end are often suffering, scared, and dying cancer patients. Don't lose perspective (as I type this I am near our pediatric cancer treatment area and heard a child scream in fear who has cancer...). Success is 100% relative. You get to define success. However, your definition of success may not match others and that is ok. Enjoy the ride! We are all so blessed to be physicians and help patients. I still keep in touch with many of my co-residents and it was an amazing time. With everything said above, I likely wouldn't change any of it as my failures helped shape who I am today. Hard to be profound in the 10 minutes I have free between meetings, but I hope this resonates with someone. Best, Dan 2. Debu Tripathy, MD Professor and Chairman | The University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center I wish I knew that one can develop a synergistic clinical expertise and research focus by simply asking questions. The most ponderous questions you generate as you go through your training can drive your career - whether you will focus on the clinical, the research, or both aspects of your queries. Hypothesis-driven research yields clinical breakthroughs. The riskier questions bring high rewards, and the more straightforward ones may bring quicker answers. Results that benefit your patients are the most elevating. For me, team science is more fun and interactive - and in my opinion, more productive while allowing you to share responsibilities and fruits of labor. Finally, I really enjoy sharing my research with my patients (yes, my clinic tends to run late) - they appreciate the fact that our profession is really looking after them, and that we are passionate about change. My research question as a 2nd year fellow at UCSF (in 1989) was, "why does this newly discovered gene named HER2/neu make cancer cells more aggressive?" I used anti-sense DNA to knock down HER2 expression and needed a positive control antibody, which I got from a colleague at Genentech. This antibody (named 4D5) worked much better than anti-sense! A colleague fellow, Jose Baselga at Memorial Sloan Kettering, was studying the same antibody in mice bearing HER2+ breast cancer xenografts with encouraging results. Our respective faculty mentors lobbied Genentech to develop this antibody as a drug (which they did reluctantly), and together we ended up conducting and publishing the first humanized 4D5 (trastuzumab) clinical article, a Phase II monotherapy trial in refractory HER2+ breast cancer 7 years later ( 1 ). I continue to ask questions that naturally jump out even with the most casual observations - I find those that resonate with others, and we are off to the races. I wish I knew what a good question was worth earlier. 1. Baselga et al., PMID 8622019 . 3. Simon M. Helfgott, MD Associate Professor | Harvard Medical School Wholeheartedly endorse Dr. Daniel E. Spratt's Fifteen Commandments - very applicable to Rheumatology Practice as well. 4. Paul Harker-Murray, MD, PhD Assistant Professor | Children’s Wisconsin I will work harder than many. I will be compensated less than many, but enough. I will love the work I do. 5. Michael Auerbach, MD Clinical Professor of Medicine | Georgetown University School of Medicine My residency was 40 years ago. I wish I know the outcome of my then future work with intravenous iron, the truth about safety and administration, and its role in the management of earth’s commonest malady. It has been a rewarding path, the last 40 years, but at least half of those years were spent learning about the inaccurate folklore of danger.

title: Case Study: YouTuber Builds Powerful One-of-a-Kind PC Chassis With Xometry’s Manufacturing Services
summary: Discover how Josh Sniffen, the YouTuber behind the popular PC-building channel Not From Concentrate, leaned on Xometry for a wide range of manufacturing options, personalized DFM feedback, and order management support for his latest creation: the HEXO ATX.
body_text: “With the S3 MINI, I wanted to realize my passion for my childhood idea of the ‘PC Console.’ I had always imagined making a gaming PC tiny so you could bring it to a friend’s house to game,” recounted the designer and artist. “I'm really happy the idea has permeated the industry. It’s crazy to think that in 2007, the concept was ridiculed at various PC shows I took it to, but now the “Console Case” is a common PC layout. The S3, S4M-C, S4M, and S4T are now in the living rooms of thousands of people from 77 countries around the world.” For his latest PC creation, dubbed HEXO ATX, Sniffen wanted to find a way to do more with less. He aimed to use the most powerful retail consumer hardware available for his PC chassis while cooling it with only two fans. Any owner of a high-end PC will tell you that high-performance machines can produce a lot of heat. In order for this build to succeed, Sniffen would need to optimize his build layout by folding the components inward for active cooling in a true “chimney” style. Cold air would cool the power supply, pump, chipset, RAM, and mosfets before entering the low restriction heat exchanger, which would use liquid to cool the CPU and GPU. Sniffen would also need to source parts from multiple manufacturing processes for the computer case. Some of these manufacturing options were chosen because they were the only viable options, while others grew from his desire to learn something new. While he has historically done a lot of CNC machining in-house, Sniffen wanted to try to use SLS 3D printing to produce plastic parts that would complement this project. When asked why he chose to work with Xometry, Sniffed replied, “I needed access to a lot of machine work and different technologies, and Xometry has all the capabilities I need. It's a one-stop shop when you normally have to go to three or four places.”

title: Reclutamiento automatizado: La manera más eficiente de adaptar tus prácticas de reclutamiento
summary: Estas prácticas de reclutamiento automatizado pueden ayudarte a contratar personas de forma más rápida y, al mismo tiempo, llevar un proceso personalizado y centrado en el candidato.
body_text: Reclutar candidatos es un trabajo difícil que implica siempre constantes cambios. Necesitas publicar tus vacantes en las bolsas de empleo adecuadas, filtrar decenas (o cientos) de solicitudes y CVs, seleccionar a los candidatos indicados, pasar por una serie de entrevistas; sin mencionar todo el papeleo en el proceso. ¡Es demasiado! Por esta razón, la automatización se está volviendo cada vez más popular entre los reclutadores y áreas de recursos humanos. Las herramientas adecuadas pueden ayudar a gestionar las publicaciones y el marketing, evaluar y filtrar candidatos y proporcionar un sistema de gestión de relaciones con los candidatos que mantenga dinámico el pool de talento de la empresa. 👌 Profundicemos en este tema para conocer todos los beneficios y mostrarte algunas formas esenciales para automatizar tu proceso de reclutamiento. ¿Por qué el reclutamiento automatizado es cada vez más importante? En pocas palabras, el reclutamiento es una tarea difícil. Comencemos observando una encuesta reciente de Glassdoor que dice que el 86% de los profesionales de RRHH piensan que el reclutamiento se está convirtiendo en una forma de marketing . Las estadísticas muestran que el reclutamiento es cada vez más complejo a medida que es necesario analizar más información para encontrar a la persona adecuada para el puesto. Sólo considera todas las características que las empresas modernas necesitan para tener éxito. Mientras la tecnología sigue avanzando, las empresas requieren más habilidades para completar las tareas diarias. Por lo tanto, los equipos de reclutamiento deben examinar los CVs y las solicitudes para encontrar precisamente estas habilidades. Actualmente los reclutadores también tienen que considerar factores como diversidad y alineación con la cultura empresarial, entre muchos otros. Es mucho trabajo para los gerentes de reclutamiento y reclutadores, lo cual hace que la automatización sea crucial para reducir la gran carga de trabajo. Esto permite que los profesionales de RRHH tengan más tiempo para concentrarse en tareas de reclutamiento que no se pueden automatizar. ¿Cuáles son los beneficios del reclutamiento automatizado? El principal beneficio del reclutamiento automatizado es que mejora la dinámica de trabajo, facilitando a los reclutadores encontrar candidatos calificados de manera organizada y rápida. Pero pongámonos específicos para que puedas ver qué partes del proceso te beneficiarán más a ti y a tu empresa. 💪 Ahorra tiempo eliminando procesos manuales El proceso de reclutamiento implica mucho trabajo manual, pero puede automatizarse fácilmente. Sólo piensa en el tiempo que dedicas a enviar recordatorios de entrevistas o actualizaciones a medida que el candidato avanza en el proceso de reclutamiento. Automatizar estas tareas puede darte tiempo para enfocarte en otras cuestiones que no son fáciles de automatizar. La clave para atraer candidatos confiables y de alta calidad La tecnología de reclutamiento automatizado debería brindarte herramientas para filtrar candidatos, solicitudes o CVs basándose en función de una variedad de características predeterminadas. Esto significa que puedes preseleccionar candidatos que presenten las características que han sido históricamente exitosas en la posiciones que estás buscando. También puedes descartar candidatos con indicadores potencialmente problemáticos. El resultado es candidatos más confiables y de mayor calidad. Esto reduce el tiempo que dedicas al proceso de filtrado manual y mejora las posibilidades de asegurar y retener el talento. Crea un proceso de onboarding organizado Una vez completada la etapa de entrevistas, comienza la fase de contratación y tus herramientas de reclutamiento automatizado pueden ser muy útiles. Con el software adecuado y un buen flujo de trabajo, deberías poder seleccionar los candidatos que has decidido contratar. A partir de aquí puedes activar automáticamente los siguientes pasos del proceso: enviar los formularios y documentos fiscales para que el nuevo empleado los complete, notificar a tu equipo de RRHH que tendrá que corroborar antecedentes, liquidar sueldos, configurar beneficios, etc. Aumenta el alcance de tus vacantes Algunos software de reclutamiento automatizado ofrecen herramientas que te permiten automatizar la promoción de anuncios de empleo. A medida que se abren vacantes, puedes publicar automáticamente varios anuncios en bolsas de empleo o en redes sociales, liberando tiempo para esfuerzos de publicidad. Esta es una forma de aumentar el alcance para tus anuncios mientras que la automatización también abre otra posibilidad: la recopilación de datos. Los softwares permiten recolectar información acerca de los sitios predilectos de los candidatos y puedes utilizar dicha información para identificar qué plataforma será más útil para tu proceso de reclutamiento. 8 formas esenciales de automatizar tu proceso de reclutamiento Cuando la utilizas correctamente, la automatización puede funcionar de maravilla para acelerar tareas diarias y, al mismo tiempo, para atraer un mayor número de candidatos de calidad. Entonces, ¿cuál es la mejor forma de hacerlo? A continuación, tenemos algunos tips, trucos y buenas prácticas para ti. 1) Utiliza IA para automatizar tu comunicación con candidatos La inteligencia artificial continúa creciendo, con una proyección de un 38.1% de tasa de crecimiento anual sobre la década pasada. Se utiliza para el análisis de datos, así como para enviar respuestas y actualizaciones. La comunicación es una de las tareas que más tiempo demandan a los reclutadores. Usar la inteligencia artificial y la automatización para responder preguntas frecuentes y enviar correos electrónicos de seguimiento puede ahorrarte mucho trabajo. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Utiliza chatbots para crear un panel en donde los candidatos puedan hacer preguntas sobre cómo enviar su solicitud o su CV para postularse a tus vacantes. Con la IA, los chatbots también pueden brindar respuestas rápidas a los candidatos acerca del estado de su solicitud. Configura correos electrónicos automáticos para enviar documentos que tienen que completarse antes de la contratación y enviar recordatorios de fechas importantes. 2) Distribuye tus anuncios de empleo y llega a los candidatos más rápidamente Es posible automatizar el envío de anuncios de empleo. Emi facilita que los candidatos encuentren y apliquen a tus vacantes en los lugares en donde ya están buscando. También facilitamos el primer contacto con candidatos interesados o, incluso, pasivos. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Utiliza la tecnología para automatizar tus esfuerzos de reclutamiento y publicar vacantes en bolsas de empleo importantes, redes sociales y motores de búsqueda Utiliza tus redes de empleados para fomentar las búsquedas abiertas Aprovecha la automatización para llamar la atención de los candidatos en tu pool de talento 3) Monitorea y mide oportunidades de networking automáticamente Las redes sociales también son un buen lugar para reclutar, especialmente talento operativo. En el 2021, el 86% de las personas en búsqueda de empleo utilizaron social media, siendo Facebook la más usada. La utilizan para investigar descripciones de empleo, evaluar la reputación y cultura de los empleadores, conocer las historias de empleados y, por último, enviar su solicitud. ¿Por qué no automatizar esto también? Existen muchas más y mejores oportunidades en las redes sociales que van más allá de la publicidad. Puedes crear tu pool de talento e impulsar candidatos por medio de contenido en plataformas como Facebook, Twitter, Instagram e, incluso, TikTok. La automatización te ayudará a mantenerte actualizado con publicaciones y medir el engagement. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Utiliza una app de gestión de redes sociales que te permita programar publicaciones dentro de la misma para publicarlas más tarde. Usa tu plataforma de reclutamiento para generar links y medir automáticamente de dónde provienen tus mejores candidatos. Crea contenido diseñado para atraer candidatos y adáptalo a la plataforma en la que lo publicas. Siéntete libre de mezclar contenido “universal”, como imágenes que funcionan para todas las plataformas con publicaciones con formatos más largos. Utiliza tu app de gestión de redes sociales para recopilar información acerca de tus publicaciones. Esto te permite medir el interés y el engagement para que puedas identificar qué plataformas y contenidos son más valiosos. 4) Automatiza la planificación, la coordinación y el proceso de entrevistas de tu equipo Los reclutadores trabajan con pools de talento masivos. Es probable que tu equipo tenga un pool de talento al cual dar seguimiento, pero si no lo tienes, podrías considerar establecer uno para optimizar tu proceso de búsqueda y reclutamiento. 🔍 La ventaja es que una gran parte del seguimiento a tu pool de talento se puede automatizar. Esto reduce la carga laboral de tu equipo para que todos puedan enfocarse en lo que son expertos: encontrar a los mejores candidatos. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Utiliza un software diseñado específicamente para el mejor pool de talento. Esto te brindará más herramientas para automatizar los pasos de tu proceso. Usa un software para automatizar tu agenda lo más posible, y realizar tareas como enviar notificaciones sobre cuándo abren y cierran vacantes, fechas para enviar solicitudes, etc. Las herramientas de automatización deberían poder ayudarte a planificar todo el proceso de entrevistas. Configura tu software de reclutamiento para enviar notificaciones a los candidatos que han sido seleccionados para las mismas. Dependiendo de las herramientas que uses, puedes incluso enviar templates de preguntas a los entrevistados. 5) Automatiza tareas manuales y repetitivas Hay muchas tareas pequeñas que se repiten diaria, semanal y mensualmente para que el proceso funcione. Dependiendo de tu empresa, estas tareas pueden variar. Algunas pueden centrarse en la atracción de talento y otras, en recursos humanos o administración del día a día. En cualquier caso, existen muchas oportunidades de automatización. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Piensa en las reuniones de equipo, ¿puedes automatizar los recordatorios semanales por correo electrónico? Las áreas de recursos humanos pueden automatizar muchos aspectos, como liquidación de sueldos, renovación de beneficios, etc., así como configurar recordatorios en una plataforma específica para tareas de RRHH. Un software de reclutamiento automatizado debería ser capaz de hacer algunas de las tareas pesadas por ti, como escanear tu base de datos de cientos de perfiles de candidatos para identificar a quiénes agregar a tu lista de seleccionados. 6) ¿Cómo identificar a los mejores candidatos? Automatizando el proceso de filtrado Si tu marketing funciona, aumentarás el interés de los candidatos y, si todo sale bien, llegará un gran volumen de solicitudes y CVs. Esta es una de las áreas más importantes en las cuales la automatización puede ayudarte: en lugar de revisar manualmente todos los CVs, utiliza softwares de reclutamiento que hagan una preselección por ti. Además de reducir la carga laboral, automatizar la preselección tiene otros beneficios. Hace que sea menos probable que los buenos candidatos sean excluidos accidentalmente por sesgos inconscientes , los cuales se refieren a sesgos asociados con una característica, persona o grupo. Puedes no ser consciente de que tienes sesgos, es por eso que son “inconscientes”. De cualquier forma, estos sesgos pueden causar que reclutadores con buenas intenciones descarten a un candidato que puede ser el indicado para el puesto. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Analiza continuamente las métricas clave, como la cantidad de contrataciones en relación a la cantidad de entrevistas y la tasa de éxito a largo plazo de los candidatos contratados. Luego, utiliza esa información para redefinir el proceso de preselección. Filtra por rasgos o características que han demostrado que predicen un mal desempeño. Por el contrario, asegúrate de filtrar por las características, aspectos positivos y experiencia del candidato que se correlacionen con el éxito a largo plazo en los roles que buscas. Si sueles trabajar con múltiples candidatos a la vez, considera invertir en herramientas de filtrado impulsadas por machine learning. Estas herramientas utilizan IA para optimizar el proceso de preselección y, que en consecuencia de ello, puedas encontrar al mejor talento fácilmente. 7) Envía automáticamente recordatorios de eventos a los candidatos para reducir las ausencias Los candidatos son personas ocupadas. Algunos tienen múltiples entrevistas agendadas alrededor de su horario de trabajo. Los recordatorios automáticos pueden ayudar a minimizar las ausencias simplemente recordando al entrevistado un compromiso que puede haber olvidado. Los recordatorios también sirven como señal de que la empresa toma el proceso de entrevistas con seriedad y que los candidatos potenciales también deberían hacerlo. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Utiliza una herramienta que te permita enviar recordatorios de entrevistas por diferentes medios, como correo electrónico o SMS, y asegúrate de saber cuál prefiere el entrevistado. Envía mensajes cortos, amables y profesionales que incluyan una o dos oraciones de saludo, y el día y hora de la entrevista. Si tienes entrevistas por videollamada, también envía el link. Usa integraciones cuando sea posible para permitir que los entrevistados agreguen la fecha a su calendario fácilmente. Por ejemplo, un correo electrónico puede tener un link u opción de agregar la fecha al Google Calendar, Outlook o Apple Calendar. 8) Optimiza el proceso de reclutamiento automatizando la revisión de antecedentes Un software de reclutamiento debe incluir un sistema de seguimiento de aplicantes (ATS), y el ATS debe proporcionar funcionalidades que permitan optimizar la revisión de antecedentes. Una vez que los candidatos son seleccionados y entrevistados, lo ideal es que el ATS inicie la revisión de antecedentes como parte del flujo de trabajo. Tips, trucos y buenas prácticas Automatiza la búsqueda de candidatos para que tu ATS genere un reporte fácil de leer. Asegúrate que el ATS pueda enviarte notificaciones sobre problemas que tengas que investigar más adelante. Un ATS inteligente también eliminará la mayoría de candidatos falsos o no válidos (por ejemplo, personas que tienen el mismo nombre que el solicitante pero no son indicadas para el puesto). title: Boom Supersonic Reaches Overture Superfactory Milestone | Newsroom | Boom Supersonic
summary: Boom Supersonic Reaches Overture Superfactory Milestone
body_text: Sep 20, 2023 Boom Supersonic Reaches Overture Superfactory Milestone Construction on Overture’s final assembly line remains on track for completion in 2024 DENVER, September 20, 2023 — Boom Supersonic , the company building the world’s fastest airliner, today shared a progress update on the construction of the Overture Superfactory. The Overture Superfactory is a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility located on a 62-acre campus at the Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina. Overture is Boom’s sustainable supersonic airliner, capable of flying twice as fast as today’s commercial planes on up to 100% sustainable aviation fuel (SAF). Boom commemorated a significant construction milestone by “topping out” the Overture Superfactory when the final structural beam was raised into place, completing the building’s frame. Boom recently finished the decking on top of the structure, began installing the metal side panels which make up the walls, and started pouring the concrete flooring slabs. With a significant portion of the exterior building constructed, the Overture Superfactory continues to take shape and remains on track for completion in 2024. “We continue to be pleased with the progress on the Overture Superfactory, our final assembly line for Overture,” said Chris Taylor, vice president of manufacturing at Boom Supersonic. “This milestone is a testament to the hard work of the numerous trade teams who are building the Superfactory, and marks an important step forward in building the sustainable supersonic future in the Piedmont Triad.” In 2022, Boom Supersonic announced the Piedmont Triad International Airport in Greensboro, North Carolina as the home to the Overture Superfactory. Construction began on the site in January 2023, and since then, Boom has been building the campus in sections, focusing first on the final assembly line where Boom will have the capacity to produce up to 33 Overture aircraft per year, which can grow to 66 per year with the addition of a second line. The Overture Superfactory is roughly 150,000 square feet with an additional 24,000 square feet of office space. “Our vision for the Piedmont Triad International Airport is to become the hub for aviation innovation,” said Kevin Baker, Executive Director of the Piedmont Triad Airport Authority. “Boom is positioned to define the next century of progress in air travel, and we are proud to see their vision taking shape in our backyard with the Overture Superfactory in the Triad.” Looking ahead, Boom will continue construction of the Overture Superfactory with BE&K Building Group and their design partner, BRPH. The building will be LEED certified in keeping with Boom’s commitment to environmental sustainability. “BE&K Building Group has delivered disciplined teams of experts providing decades of design and construction expertise to the aviation and aerospace sector,” said Frank Holley, President and CEO of BE&K Building Group. “We are honored to team with Boom, our design partner BRPH, the Piedmont Triad Airport Authority, and the project’s many other participants in the construction of the Overture Superfactory.” Boom provided a detailed look at the facility’s progress during the Paris Air Show in July, along with significant Symphony and Overture program advances. Updates include signing structural supplier agreements with Aernnova for Overture’s wings, Leonardo for the fuselage and wing box, and Aciturri for the empennage. title: 3 Stretching exercises for desk workers - Get Relief from Neck, Back and Wrist Pain
summary: Stretching exercises are a practical solution for joint pain and discomfort. Learn how you can include them in your daily routine and get relief from Neck, Back and Wrist Pain
body_text: Are you a desk worker? If yes, we understand the discomfort and stiffness resulting from sitting for extended periods. In today's fast-paced work environment, it's common for many individuals to spend long hours sitting at a desk. Unfortunately, our present sedentary lifestyle can take a toll on our joints, leading to stiffness, pain, and discomfort. That's why it's crucial to prioritise joint health and take steps to alleviate these issues. Stretching exercises are a practical solution for joint pain and discomfort. Including some of the best stretching exercises in your daily routine can enhance joint movements, reduce stiffness, and alleviate joint pain. Are you looking for stretches for office workers? Read on to find the best stretches for office workers and how to do stretching exercises for desk workers. Jump to section Understanding the Impact of Desk Work on Joints How Does Stretching Help Desk Workers? Back Stretches for Office Workers: Techniques and Benefits Wrist and Hand Stretches for Desk Workers Incorporating Stretching into the Workdays To Conclude Understanding the Impact of Desk Work on Joints Prolonged desk work can have a significant impact on joint health. Sitting at work for lengthy periods can pave the way to poor posture, which can cause strain on the joints. Desk work can lead to joint pain , stiffness , and even arthritis . When sitting for long periods, The muscles in the body become weak, and The joints become stiff. This can cause joint pain and inflammation , especially in the neck, back, shoulders, and hips. These areas are particularly vulnerable due to the repetitive motions involved in typing, using a mouse, and looking at a computer screen for extended periods. Additionally, sitting for long periods can cause poor circulation , leading to swelling and discomfort in the joints. Common Joint Discomfort Experienced by Office Workers Carpal Tunnel Syndrome One common joint issue you can face as a working woman is carpal tunnel syndrome. It occurs due to Median nerve compression. Symptoms include: Severe pain Hands and fingers experience tingling sensation and numbness Tennis Elbow Another common problem is tennis elbow , which leads to severe pain in the outer part of the elbow and forearm. It is often a result of repetitive gripping and twisting motions, such as using a computer mouse. Neck and Shoulder Pain Neck and shoulder pain are also prevalent among office workers. Poor posture while working, such as hunching over a desk, can strain the muscles and joints in these areas. Back Pain Back pain is also a frequent complaint, often due to prolonged sitting in an unsupportive chair. How Does Stretching Help Desk Workers? As you spend more and more time sitting at your desk, taking care of your body is becoming increasingly important. And, of course, incorporate healthy habits into your work routines. One of the best things you can do for your physical health is to incorporate stretching into your desk routine. Here is how: Improved Posture Your posture can become compromised when you spend long hours sitting in one position. You can help alleviate neck, shoulder, and back tension by stretching regularly, leading to pain and discomfort. This, in turn, can help to improve your overall posture. Better Circulation Blood flow can become restricted due to prolonged sitting, leading to fatigue and decreased concentration. By stretching your muscles, you increase blood flow to them, which helps to improve oxygen and nutrient delivery to your cells. Improved Flexibility Stretching exercises can increase flexibility by elongating the muscles and improving their range of motion. When you perform stretching exercises regularly, your muscles become more adaptable. Moreover, they can move through a more extensive range of motion without feeling tight or restricted. Mental Health Benefits Stretching has several mental health advantages. It helps to prevent and decrease anxiety and stress, which are common among desk-bound workers. Regular stretching can also help improve your mood and increase your overall well-being. Neck Stretches for Office Workers: Techniques and Benefits Here are some specific neck stretches for office workers that can effectively relieve tension and discomfort in the neck: Neck Stretch How to Perform? Sit or stand up straight. Lower your left ear toward your left shoulder. Use your left hand to apply a slight additional stretch by placing it on the right side of your head and gently pulling. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds. Repeat on the other side. Your Neck Will Thank You! This stretch targets the muscles on the sides of your neck, known as the sternocleidomastoid muscles. These muscles can become tense due to poor posture and holding your head in the same position for extended periods. By tilting your head to the side, you lengthen and stretch these muscles, helping to release tension and improve flexibility. Neck Rotation Stretch How to Do It? Sit or stand with good posture. Slowly turn your head to the right, looking over your right shoulder. You can use your hand on your chin to gently guide the stretch for a deeper stretch. Hold for 15-30 seconds. Repeat on the left side. Benefits and Explanation This stretch targets the muscles on your neck and upper back. These muscles can become tight from activities like watching a computer screen or phone for extended periods. Rotating your head helps release tension in these muscles and improves your neck's range of motion. Chin Tucks How to Do It? Sit or stand with proper posture. Gently tuck your chin in, creating a double chin. Hold for a few seconds and release. You can repeat this stretch multiple times. Benefits and Explanation This stretch helps counteract the forward head posture that often develops from looking down at screens. It targets the muscles at the front of your neck and upper back. By tucking your chin in, you activate the muscles that support proper neck alignment and relieve tension that can accumulate from poor posture. Shoulder Blade Squeeze How to Do It? Sit with your spine straight with your arms at your sides. Squeeze your shoulder blades together gently. Hold for 5-10 seconds and release. Repeat a few times. Benefits and Explanation This stretch acts on the muscles between your shoulder blades and upper back, contributing to neck discomfort when tight. By squeezing your shoulder blades together, you engage the muscles that help maintain good posture and decrease the tension in the upper back and neck area. Back Stretches for Office Workers: Techniques and Benefits Here are some back stretches for office workers that can help counteract the strain caused by prolonged sitting and promote better posture while reducing back pain: Cat-Cow Stretch How to Do It? Stand on your hands and knees, with your wrists aligned under your shoulders and the knees under your hips. Slowly inhale as you arch your back and lift your head and tailbone (Cow Pose). Gently exhale as you round your back, tucking your jaw or chin to your chest and tucking your tailbone under (Cat pose). Repeat this flowing motion for several rounds, coordinating with your breath. Benefits The Cat-Cow stretch helps improve the flexibility of your spine and engages the muscles along your back. It promotes spinal mobility and counteracts the stiffness from sitting for extended periods. The alternating arching and rounding of your back can alleviate tension and improve posture. Child's Pose How to Do It? Begin on your hands and knees. Sit on your heels, extending your arms in front of you. Lower your forehead towards the floor and relax your back. Hold this position and breathe deeply. Benefits The child's pose gently stretches the muscles of the lower back, aiding to relieve tension and discomfort. It promotes relaxation and helps lengthen the spine, which can counteract the compression from sitting. Seated Forward Fold How to Do It? Sit with both your legs extended in front of you. Hinge at your hips and fold forward, reaching towards your feet or ankles. Keep your spine straight and lengthen your spine as you fold. Hold the stretch and breathe deeply. Benefits The Seated Forward Fold stretches the muscles along the entire length of your back, from your upper to lower back. It helps release tension in the hamstrings and lower back, which can become tight from sitting. Regular practice can improve flexibility and contribute to better posture. Bridge Pose How to Do It? Position yourself on your back with both your knees bent and your feet resting flat on the ground, spaced at hip-width. Press through your feet and lift your hips, creating a bridge shape. Hold the pose while keeping your shoulders and feet grounded. Benefits Bridge Pose strengthens the muscles in your lower back, glutes, and hamstrings. It opens up the front of the body, counteracting the hunched posture resulting from sitting. Regular practice can improve spinal flexibility and alleviate back pain. Wrist and Hand Stretches for Desk Workers Here are some wrist and hand stretches that can help prevent discomfort and enhance joint mobility, which is especially important for those who spend long hours typing or using computers: Wrist Flexor Stretch How to Do It? Extend your arm in front of you, with the palm facing upwards. Use your other hand to gently bend your wrist so your fingers point towards the floor. You should feel a stretch along the underside of your forearm. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds. Repeat on the other wrist. Benefits and Explanation This stretch targets the wrist flexor muscles located on the palm side of your forearm. These muscles can become tight from activities like typing or using a mouse. By stretching the wrist flexors, you improve flexibility and prevent the discomfort that can arise from overuse. Wrist Extensor Stretch How to Do It? Extend both your arms in front of you, palm facing downwards. Use your other hand to gently bend your wrist so your fingers point towards the floor. You should feel a stretch on the top side of your forearm. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds. Repeat on the other wrist. Benefits and Explanation This stretch targets the wrist extensor muscles on the back of your forearm. These muscles often get used when typing or gripping objects. Stretching the wrist extensors improves joint mobility and helps prevent discomfort or strain in the wrist area. Finger and Hand Stretch How to Do It? Extend your arm in front of you. Use your other hand to bend your fingers back toward your wrist gently. You can do this stretch for each finger individually or all fingers together. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds. Repeat, on the other hand. Benefits and Explanation This stretch acts on the muscles and tendons in your fingers and hands. It helps maintain flexibility in the finger joints and can alleviate tension caused by repetitive motions. Thumb Stretch How to Do It? Hold your hand out in front of you, palm facing you. Slowly pull your thumb back toward your wrist. Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds. Repeat with the other thumb. Benefits and Explanation This stretch targets the muscles and tendons of the thumb. It helps maintain the thumb's range of motion, essential for various hand movements and tasks. Wrist Circles How to Do It? Hold your arm out in front of you, palm facing down. Make small circles with your wrist, moving clockwise and counterclockwise. Perform the circles for about 15-20 seconds in each direction. Benefits and Explanation Wrist circles help increase the mobility of the wrist joint and improve the circulation of synovial fluid, which lubricates the joint. Incorporating Stretching into the Workdays Integrating stretching exercises into your daily routine can be easy with these practical tips. Micro-Breaks Set a timer to remind yourself to take short breaks throughout the day. Every hour or so, take a 5-minute break to perform a few simple stretches. Stretching Sessions Dedicate specific time slots for longer stretching sessions. Aim for at least 15-20 minutes of focused stretching. Morning Routine Incorporate a few minutes of stretching into your morning routine. Start with gentle stretches to wake up your muscles and increase flexibility. Evening Wind-Down Use stretching as a way to wind down before bed. Perform calming stretches to relax your body and mind. This can improve sleep quality and help reduce any accumulated stress from the day. Desk Stretches You can do seated stretches to avoid muscle stiffness. You can do neck stretches, shoulder rolls, wrist stretches, and seated spinal twists without attracting much attention. Incorporate While Waiting Use moments when you're waiting, such as waiting for your coffee to brew or a meeting to start, to fit in quick stretches. In small spaces, you can perform calf raises, toe touches, and hip flexor stretches. Multitasking Combine stretching with other activities. For instance, perform stretches that don't require much focus while watching TV or reading, such as hamstring stretches or seated forward bends. Stretches for Chores Integrate stretching with household chores. For example, you can perform calf stretches while brushing your teeth by standing on tiptoes. Workout Complement After a workout, your muscles are warm and more pliable. Take advantage of this by incorporating static stretches for major muscle groups. This can improve flexibility and aid in recovery. Social Stretching Invite friends, family members, or coworkers to join you in stretching sessions. It can be fun and motivating to incorporate stretching into your routine. Variety is Key Keep your routine interesting by incorporating a variety of stretches. Focus on different muscle groups and experiment with different types of stretches. To Conclude We have discussed some of the best exercises for office workers, mainly stretching exercises for office workers. Keep in mind that consistency is the key to success. Begin with small, manageable steps and slowly increase the duration and intensity of your stretching routine. By incorporating these stretches for desk workers into your daily routine, you can experience improved flexibility, reduced muscle tension, and enhanced well-being. Remember, your health is an investment. By maintaining good joint health, you can ensure a more comfortable and productive work experience. title: On the Road to Effective Data Analyses
summary: Doximity is building the default Clinical AI Suite. Read more on our Technical Blog.
body_text: In the modern business landscape, the significance of data analysis cannot be overstated. It empowers organizations to uncover insights, make informed decisions, and gain a competitive edge by deciphering the hidden patterns within vast datasets. Data analysis is the cornerstone of strategic innovation and effective decision-making in today's dynamic markets. At Doximity, data is crucial to the success of business operations, playing a key role in every step of the product development cycle. From determining the potential of new features to testing and tracking their performance, data analysts and business intelligence analysts are critical to Doximity's success. Data analysts are equipped with powerful data analysis tools. While the variety of tools makes data analysis enjoyable, it still requires practice and self-reflection to create engaging analyses that cater to their audience. Here are a few tips for making analyses more compelling and useful. Ask the right questions from your data Every data analysis begins with an open-ended product question, which must be broken down into more specific questions related to the data. Taking the time to structure the analysis with well-defined questions can prevent analysts from getting lost in unnecessary details. Brainstorming early with colleagues and product managers can provide valuable insights and help identify and avoid potential data issues that could lead to flawed findings. As an example, consider the open-ended production question - "Why is the engagement with component x of our app increasing/decreasing in the last 2 months?" Upon brainstorming, this leads to questions “closer” to the data, such as: Is this a local high/low or an all-time high/low? In particular, have we seen seasonality with this metric in recent years? Is there a competing component of the app whose engagement has gone down/up in recent times that is correlated with this component’s engagement going up/down? Write readable code Although coding as a data analyst may not be as strict as that of a software developer, adhering to certain rules can make queries less error-prone and easier to review. For SQL queries, using Common Table Expressions (CTEs) can improve code readability and ease debugging. Organizing Python code into functions reduces repetition, especially when generating multiple charts with slight variations in input data frames. Breaking logical blocks of SQL into CTE’s makes code readable and easier to debug Moving the code to generate charts into functions can reduce repetitive code Visual representations are powerful Selecting the right visualization for data analysis is a pivotal step in effectively communicating insights. It hinges on a nuanced understanding of the data's nature and the objectives of the analysis. Begin by comprehending the type of data you possess – whether it's numerical, categorical, or temporal – and the relationships you aim to highlight, such as comparisons, trends, or distributions. Consider the audience too; the chosen visualization should resonate with their level of expertise and help convey the message clearly. From bar charts and line graphs to heatmaps and scatter plots, each type of visualization has its strengths. Strive to match the visualization's characteristics with the inherent traits of your data. Ultimately, experimentation and iteration play a role – don't hesitate to try different options and refine your choices based on how effectively they convey insights, and aid in the decision-making process. Add a summary of findings on the top (BLUF) In military communications, BLUF stands for “bottom line up front,” meaning put the most important details first. To make analyses more reader-friendly, begin with a bulleted summary of the main findings. This allows stakeholders to immediately grasp the key insights without having to delve into lengthy analyses, acknowledging readers' time constraints while elevating the impact of the insights offered. Give the user control of the narrative Make the charts interactive by adding filters (e.g., date filters) to provide users with control over the data they want to explore. This feature encourages them to observe insights they may not have originally considered, promoting a collaborative approach to data analysis. We like to think of this as crowd-sourcing data analysis. 😜 At the same time, making a dashboard too “filter happy” can convolute usability of the dashboard, and at the back end, may have unintended consequences when various filters interact with each other. Striking the right balance requires engaging stakeholders in a dialogue to determine which filters prove most beneficial. Iterate on the Analysis Resist the urge to share analyses with stakeholders immediately after answering the initial questions. Data analysis is both a science and an art. Writing SQL queries can put us in a somewhat rigid and almost mechanical frame of mind, thus limiting our ability to think creatively. Therefore, taking a little more time to review and revisit the analysis with fresh eyes can lead to new discoveries and more creative insights. Consider sharing your preliminary findings with a peer for early feedback and additional ideas as well. Take a leaf out of others’ notebooks Encourage a culture of reviewing and sharing data analyses within the organization. Here at Doximity, we ensure that every analysis gets code reviewed by another analyst before it goes into production. This process ensures accuracy and adherence to best practices, while providing analysts with the opportunity to learn from each other and incorporate new techniques into their work. In conclusion, mastering the skill of data analysis takes time, practice, reflection, and learning from others' experiences. By following these tips and continuously improving their craft, data analysts can make their work more effective and enjoyable. title: Auditoria ESG: por que e como realizar na gestão de fornecedores?
summary: A auditoria ESG na gestão de fornecedores é uma forma de proteger sua empresa de vários riscos. Confira como realizar em 4 passos + 2 dicas!
body_text: A auditoria ESG consiste em uma análise aprofundada da atuação de um negócio perante os três pilares relacionados ao conceito . Em outras palavras, significa verificar, detalhadamente, como está a atuação de uma empresa no que se refere a boas práticas ambientais, sociais e de governança. Do ponto de vista da estruturação de uma rede de fornecedores confiável, esse tipo de auditoria ajuda a proteger a sua companhia de uma série de riscos. Por exemplo, imagine que, durante a auditoria, você identifique que um fornecedor em potencial apresenta falhas no processo de descarte de resíduos, ou que não está em divergência com leis trabalhistas. Nesse caso, você tem a chance de lidar com as questões levantadas antes da contratação, evitando que afetem a dinâmica e a imagem do seu negócio ao fechar a parceria. Além disso, pode ponderar sobre o que vale mais a pena: assumir os riscos ou buscar outra empresa fornecedora para abastecer a sua. Sendo assim, é certo dizer que realizar uma auditoria ESG evita que a sua companhia passe por diversas outras ameaças e problemas no relacionamento com os fornecedores, tais como financeiros, reputacionais, jurídicos, de desabastecimento, entre outros. Então, como realizar a verificação precisamente e, com isso, diminuir as ameaças características desse tipo de contratação? É sobre esse assunto que falaremos neste artigo. Por isso, siga a leitura e confira tudo sobre a auditoria ESG! O que é uma auditoria ESG? A auditoria ESG é um processo de análise pontual e aprofundado dos processos adotados por uma empresa, bem como dos resultados obtidos, no que se refere a boas práticas voltadas para os pilares ambiental, social e de governança . Explicando de outro modo, trata-se de um estudo minucioso, sistemático e cuidadoso das atividades ESG que um negócio adota, que tem por objetivo verificar se essas práticas estão de acordo com as ações esperadas para o ramo de atuação e legislações vigentes. Para chegar a essa constatação, a auditagem mensura, analisa, verifica e valida documentos e processos como: relatórios de sustentabilidade; KPIs socioambientais, econômicos e de governança; aderência dos pilares ESG nas atividades corporativas; existência e aplicação de códigos de conduta, políticas e demais diretrizes que ajudam na implementação do conceito; entre outros pontos relacionados. Dica! Aproveite e leia também: “ O que é a auditoria de compliance e por que ela é tão importante? ” Por que fazer uma auditoria ESG nos fornecedores? Incluir a auditoria ESG na gestão de fornecedores do seu negócio é uma forma de mitigar os riscos inerentes do modelo de contratação. Tais riscos incluem as ameaças geradas pelos parceiros que podem afetar diretamente a dinâmica do seu negócio e, consequentemente, o crescimento e a lucratividade. Alguns bons exemplos de riscos relacionados aos pilares socioambiental e de governança que podem estar relacionados aos processos e práticas dos fornecedores são: desmatamento descontrolado; emissão de gases de efeito estufa; descumprimento de leis de proteção ambiental. exploração de mão de obra infantil ; uso de trabalho escravo ; desrespeito aos direitos humanos. práticas ilícitas, como corrupção de fornecedores e lavagem de dinheiro; não tratar corretamente a Pessoa Politicamente Exposta no quadro societário; ausência de transparência nos processos. Em resumo, é possível dizer que realizar uma auditoria com foco no conceito ESG é uma medida de segurança a favor do seu negócio . Afinal, o processo permite identificar, previamente, riscos como os que acabamos de citar. Ao ter a informação nas mãos, você tem a chance de ponderar sobre o que é mais interessante e seguro para sua companhia, conforme o grau de ameaça identificada — por exemplo, trazer o fornecedor para a sua cadeia de suprimentos mesmo sob algum risco, ou buscar por outro que se mostre mais preparado e alinhado aos 3 pilares. Leia também: “ Gestão de riscos de fornecedores: TUDO sobre como mitigar ameaças! ” Quais são os critérios de auditoria ESG? Os critérios de uma auditoria com foco ESG estão diretamente vinculados às bases socioambientais e de governança . Quanto a isso, é importante destacar que cada empresa pode determinar seus próprios fundamentos e parâmetros de auditagem, de acordo com o segmento, modelo de negócio e forma de atuação. Entretanto, em linhas gerais, os critérios ESG que entram na verificação são: ambiental : tem, por objetivo, verificar a relação da empresa com o meio ambiente, o impacto das atividades realizadas na natureza e quais medidas adota para minimizá-los; social : esse é um ESG rating que mensura a postura e as condutas da empresa perante seus stakeholders , a exemplo de: cumprimento de leis trabalhistas, adoção de programas de diversidade e inclusão, e outras práticas relacionadas; governança : essa parte da auditoria é voltada para a gestão do negócio, por isso, inclui a verificação da transparência dos processos, o combate a fraudes, a responsabilidade corporativa e outras condutas similares. Como fazer uma auditoria ESG? 4 passos + 2 dicas Para fazer uma auditoria socioambiental e de governança nos fornecedores atuais e futuros da sua empresa, há alguns passos que devem ser seguidos. Entre os principais, estão: definir o escopo da auditoria : ou seja, determinar o objetivo do processo e quais áreas serão envolvidas; coletar os dados : levantar dados e informações relacionados ao conceito ESG que contribuirão para a auditagem realizada; avaliar as informações : analisar o que foi levantado anteriormente para identificação dos pontos positivos e negativos das condutas ESG adotadas pelo fornecedor; gerar o relatório final : registrar todas as percepções para, a partir daí, tomar a decisão sobre a contratação ou não da empresa fornecedora. title: ResearDesign Guidelines for Prompt Engineering Text-to-Image Generative Models
summary: Tutorials, guides and deep dives into the best techniques and research for building reliable AI.
body_text: Do not index Original Paper https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.06977 Blog URL blog.athina.ai /researd...e-models Original Paper: https://arxiv.org/abs/2109.06977 By: Vivian Liu , Lydia B. Chilton Abstract: Text-to-image generative models are a new and powerful way to generate visual artwork. However, the open-ended nature of text as interaction is double-edged; while users can input anything and have access to an infinite range of generations, they also must engage in brute-force trial and error with the text prompt when the result quality is poor. We conduct a study exploring what prompt keywords and model hyperparameters can help produce coherent outputs. In particular, we study prompts structured to include subject and style keywords and investigate success and failure modes of these prompts. Our evaluation of 5493 generations over the course of five experiments spans 51 abstract and concrete subjects as well as 51 abstract and figurative styles. From this evaluation, we present design guidelines that can help people produce better outcomes from text-to-image generative models. Summary Notes Enhancing Text-to-Image Generation with Prompt Engineering Techniques In the dynamic realm of artificial intelligence, text-to-image generative models stand out as a revolutionary advancement. These models can turn written descriptions into detailed visual art, presenting new opportunities and challenges in prompt engineering. Crafting well-designed prompts is essential to produce high-quality, relevant images. This blog explores insights from Columbia University's research, offering actionable advice for AI engineers in enterprise environments to refine text-to-image generation. Overview of Experiments Columbia University's Vivian Liu and Lydia B. Chilton conducted experiments to understand how different prompt parameters influence image quality. Their research, involving 5493 image generations across 51 themes and styles, shed light on the intricacies of prompt engineering. Key areas of focus included prompt wording, random starting points, ideal iteration counts, style handling, and the interplay between themes and styles. Detailed Findings Prompt Wording: The experiments showed that the way a prompt is phrased has a minimal impact on the outcome. The critical factors are the chosen subjects and styles. Random Seeds: Using various seeds is important, as different starting points can lead to diverse outcomes. Iteration Count: Achieving desired results doesn't require numerous iterations; an optimal range is between 100 and 500. Artistic Styles: The effectiveness of models varies with different styles, showing a preference for certain interpretations. Theme and Style Interaction: The quality of generated images is significantly influenced by the combination of a theme's abstractness and the chosen style, with concrete themes and figurative styles often leading to better results. Key Insights The research offers valuable lessons for optimizing prompt engineering: Prompt Composition: Focus on the subject and style rather than the phrasing. Variability of Seeds: Experiment with multiple seeds to find the best outcomes due to the variability in initial conditions. Efficient Iteration: Fewer iterations can be sufficient, which can make the generation process faster without sacrificing quality. Style Preferences: Be aware of model biases towards certain styles. Influence of Theme and Style: The mix of a theme's nature and the style can greatly affect the generation quality. Practical Guidelines for AI Engineers To improve text-to-image generation, engineers should: Prioritize Key Elements: Emphasize subject and style keywords in prompts. Use Multiple Seeds: Test with various seeds to handle output variability. Match Themes with Styles: Consider how the abstractness of the subject and the chosen style interact, as concrete subjects paired with figurative styles usually produce better images. Conclusion The study by Liu and Chilton offers deep insights into prompt engineering for text-to-image models, helping AI engineers use these models more effectively. By applying the study's guidelines, engineers can enhance control over image generation, leading to superior results. Looking Forward Future research will be essential for understanding how generative models interpret artistic styles and subjects more deeply. Exploring complex prompt elements like mood or specific artistic techniques could expand text-to-image generation's creative and commercial potential in AI. title: Kenvue unveils new survey data on menopause and announces sponsorship
summary: Kenvue set to attend the Annual Meeting of The Menopause Society, as the company sponsors a scholarship program in menopause education and shares new data in the women’s hormonal health space
body_text: September 27, 2023 – Kenvue Inc. (NYSE: KVUE) (“Kenvue”), the world’s largest pure-play consumer health company by revenue, will unveil new data from an attitudes and usage study during a poster presentation, “ Clearing the fog: Learning about menopause through the experiences of 4,500 women aged 40-65 ,” during the Annual Meeting of The Menopause Society in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania September 27 – 30. At the Annual Meeting, Kenvue will also announce its sponsorship and funding of The Menopause Society scholarship program, contributing to clinicians earning the credential or recredentialing as a Menopause Society Certified Practitioner (MSCP). The goal of Kenvue (the parent company of iconic brands such as Aveeno®, BAND-AID® Brand Adhesive Bandages, Johnson’s®, Listerine®, Neutrogena®, and Tylenol®) is to help expand the number of clinicians who are trained to help their patients navigate menopause by supporting the MSCP credential. Dr. Mary Jane Minkin, part of Kenvue’s Women’s Health Advisory Board and a clinical professor in the Department of Obstetrics, Gynecology, and Reproductive Sciences at the Yale University School of Medicine, called the Menopause Society’s scholarship program “crucial,” as only 31% of OB/GYN residencies in the United States offer menopause training as part of their curriculum. As a result, some individuals may find it challenging to receive menopause support and care in their local healthcare professionals’ office. “The Menopause Society’s Scholarship Program supporting the credentialing or re-credentialing of clinicians as Menopause Society Certified Practitioners (MSCPs) will have a dramatic impact in helping to treat, diagnose, and empower women at different stages of their hormonal health journey and Kenvue is proud to be a sponsor,” said Adam Ricciardone1, Global Vice President, Kenvue Self Care. The attitudes and usage study will be presented by Benjamin Klein2, Associate Director of Consumer Business Intelligence for Kenvue Self Care. The U.S.-based study included a diverse population of 4,578 women aged 40 to 65 years spanning pre-, peri- and post-menopausal stages who completed an online quantitative survey about their symptoms related to the menopause transition over a three-week period. According to the survey, over a third of peri/menopausal women (39% and 31% respectively) are experiencing symptoms of menopause that are affecting their quality of life, but many women do not seek the help they need with this transitional life stage because they do not immediately recognize that symptoms such as hot flashes, fatigue, night sweats, brain fog, memory issues and joint pain are related to menopause. “These findings clarify an opportunity to improve women’s health through the extraordinary power of everyday care,” Klein said. “By educating patients, providers and the community, we can close the menopause awareness gap to help ensure that women receive more support and feel empowered across each phase of the journey.” Klein is presenting his data on Thursday, September 28 at 6:15 pm in Franklin Hall of the Marriott Downtown Philadelphia. title: Why Is Tinnitus Worse in the Morning? What Helps
summary: Why tinnitus feels worst on waking, the role of sleep, stress and silence, plus practical steps to manage it. Clinically reviewed by Dr Evan Davies, AuD
body_text: Waking up to the unsettling sounds of tinnitus can feel like a peaceful morning has been stolen away. If you're among the many who find their tinnitus is louder in the morning, know this: you're not alone. In fact, research shows that tinnitus is perceived as louder and more distressing during the early morning hours [1]. For those hoping for quieter mornings, gaining a better understanding of tinnitus, its potential causes, and how to manage it can be helpful. While professional advice is key, there are steps you can take on your own to lessen tinnitus's disruption in your day-to-day life. In this article, we'll explore why tinnitus might be worse in the morning. We'll also discuss strategies to help you navigate and lessen the disruption it can cause, offering a path towards more peaceful mornings. Why Do I Wake Up with My Ears Ringing? If you find your ears ringing in the morning on a regular basis, it can be quite distressing. To grasp why this happens, it's helpful to have a deeper understanding of what tinnitus is and how our bodies respond to it, particularly in the early hours. While tinnitus can sound different to each individual experiencing it, it is most often described as a ringing, buzzing, or hissing sound in the ears. It's been suggested that it's not just the silence of the night that amplifies these intrusive sounds. Other factors may also explain why some people wake up with their ears ringing. These include: Sleep-Wake Cycle Our brain activity changes as we move from sleep to wakefulness. During this transition, our auditory system becomes more alert, making us more aware of sounds we might not notice during the day. This heightened state of auditory awareness can make morning tinnitus seem more intense. Psychological State Another contributing factor is the role of stress and anxiety, with stress hormones like cortisol and adrenaline potentially impacting the perception of tinnitus. When we wake up, our minds begin to process the demands of the day, potentially causing stress levels to rise and, in turn, increasing our awareness of tinnitus. Dehydration Dehydration thickens the fluid within the ears, possibly amplifying the perception of tinnitus. Since we often wake up dehydrated after a long night's sleep, this could be another reason why the internal sounds are more noticeable in the morning. Medication Certain ototoxic medications (drugs that can damage the sensory cells in the inner ear) can enhance tinnitus' intrusive sounds. If you're taking such medication and notice your tinnitus more in the morning, it's worth discussing this with your healthcare professional to explore alternative solutions. Sleep Positions Sleeping positions may seem trivial, but they could potentially affect the awareness of tinnitus upon waking. For example, lying on one side for an extended period, in some cases, can lead to increased blood pressure in the ear against the pillow, potentially intensifying tinnitus. With that said, the relationship between sleeping positions and tinnitus isn't fully understood, and more research is needed to confirm these observations. Brain Activity Our brains don't switch off while we're asleep; in fact, specific functions come alive during this phase, from memory consolidation to the processing of emotions. This heightened activity could make our brain more susceptible to internal sounds like tinnitus. Strategies to Soothe the Impact of Tinnitus in the Morning Recognising the impact tinnitus can have on your well-being is the first step towards successfully managing it. Fortunately, several strategies can help you reduce your awareness of tinnitus, particularly in the morning. Habituation Habituation, also known as ‘tuning out tinnitus’, involves allowing tinnitus to become part of your auditory landscape, much like the constant hum of a refrigerator or the ticking of a clock. In other words, you are still aware of the ringing or buzzing sounds, but they become so familiar that they are pushed to the back of your mind. This cognitive shift does not occur overnight and requires consistent effort and patience. Fortunately, there are a number of scientifically proven techniques, such as cognitive behavioural therapy (mentioned below), that can aid this process and help individuals manage their perceptions and reactions to conditions like tinnitus. Each day, even if the sounds are there when you wake up, remind yourself that they are not a threat but rather an unwanted guest. Over time, you may find that you start to notice your tinnitus less, even upon waking. Good Sleep Hygiene Maintaining good sleep hygiene can be instrumental in managing the presence of tinnitus, particularly in the morning. A stable sleep schedule, which involves going to bed and waking up at roughly the same times each day, can support your body's internal clock, promoting better sleep overall. It's also important to create a welcoming sleep environment, which could include anything from investing in comfortable bedding to ensuring your room is dark, quiet, and at a suitable temperature and reducing your exposure to blue light (emitted by devices like smartphones and laptops) in the hours leading up to bedtime. It's worth keeping an eye on what you consume in the hours before bed. Stimulants like caffeine and nicotine can disrupt your sleep as they increase your heart rate and alertness. Similarly, while alcohol might initially make you drowsy, it will lead to disrupted sleep later in the night. Mindfulness and Meditation Incorporating mindfulness and meditation into your daily routine might just make those morning tinnitus sounds a little less intrusive.
